description: MORTHAL GLOBAL SURPLUS: Swamp Apothecary. Rare swamp ingredients are abundant.
MORTHAL GLOBAL DEFICIT: No Local Smith. Basic metal tools are imported.
TOXIC FLORA: Poisons and toxic ingredients are dangerously common.
SUPERSTITION: High demand for magical protection (Soul Gems, Spells) vs Monsters.
IMPORTED STEEL: Finished steel goods command a premium due to lack of smiths.
LUMBER MILL: Functional mill keeps wood prices stable/slightly cheap.
